name: The Paladin
description: A human soldier sworn to a sacred oath: heavy armour, a longsword, and divine magic that mends and smites. The simplest sturdy warrior to learn the rules with.

fields.appearance: A broad-shouldered soldier in polished chain mail, a longsword at one hip and a worn holy symbol at the throat.
fields.biography: A former ranker who took an oath after a battle went badly. They are steady in a fight and slow to abandon anyone.

name: The Wizard
description: A high elf scholar with a spellbook, a handful of cantrips, and the best spell list in the game. Fragile at first level, but every level adds more answers.

fields.appearance: A tall high elf in a travel-stained robe, with ink on their fingers and a spellbook never far from reach.
fields.biography: A library scholar who left the stacks to see whether the old accounts were true. They take notes on everything.

name: The Cleric
description: A dwarf acolyte who heals, blesses, and turns the tide without hogging the spotlight. Divine Order: Protector adds martial weapons and heavy armour.

fields.appearance: A stocky dwarf in a chain shirt and shield, with a mace kept close and a holy symbol polished bright.
fields.biography: Raised in a temple kitchen and sent out to carry word to a distant shrine. They would rather mend a stranger than win an argument.
